name: Cloudpoint Technology Berhad
overview: Cloudpoint Technology Berhad 于2026年完成收购 CX One Sdn Bhd 全部股权，作价 RM16.80 million，此外，800,000份免费凭单。
overview_en: Cloudpoint Technology Berhad completed the acquisition of 100% equity interest in CX One Sdn Bhd for RM16.80 million in 2026, and proposed to vary and extend the timeframe for the utilisation of IPO proceeds; the company also proposed a bonus issue of up to 265,800,000 free warrants on the basis of 1 warrant for every 2 existing ordinary shares.
